questions.sentence: The report must be submitted ______ the end of the business day.
questions.explanation: 'by'는 '~까지(기한)'를 나타냅니다. 'until'은 '~까지 계속'이라는 의미로 지속적인 행위에 사용됩니다.

questions.sentence: ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor event proceeded as planned.
questions.explanation: 'Despite'는 전치사로 뒤에 명사(구)가 옵니다. 'Although'와 'While'은 접속사로 절이 따라야 합니다.

questions.sentence: The new policy will take effect ______ January 1st.
questions.explanation: 특정 날짜 앞에는 전치사 'on'을 사용합니다. 'at'은 시간, 'in'은 월/년도에 사용됩니다.

questions.sentence: All documents must be submitted in accordance ______ company policy.
questions.explanation: 'in accordance with'는 '~에 따라'라는 의미의 고정 표현입니다.

questions.sentence: The manager ______ the project since last April.
questions.explanation: 'since + 과거 시점'은 현재완료(have/has + p.p.)와 함께 사용됩니다. 과거부터 현재까지 계속되는 행위를 나타냅니다.

questions.sentence: If the budget ______ approved, the project will begin next month.
questions.explanation: 조건절(if절)에서는 미래의 일이라도 현재시제를 사용합니다. 'will be'는 조건절에서 사용하지 않습니다.

questions.sentence: By the time the CEO arrives, the presentation ______ already ______.
questions.explanation: 'By the time + 현재시제'는 미래완료(will have + p.p.)와 함께 사용되어 미래의 특정 시점까지 완료될 행위를 나타냅니다.

questions.sentence: The company requested that every employee ______ the training session.
questions.explanation: request, suggest, recommend 등의 동사 뒤 that절에서는 동사원형을 사용합니다 (가정법 현재/당위법).

questions.sentence: The architect ______ designed the building received an award.
questions.explanation: 'who'는 사람을 선행사로 하는 주격 관계대명사입니다. 관계절에서 주어 역할을 합니다.

questions.sentence: The client ______ we met yesterday approved the proposal.
questions.explanation: 'whom'은 사람을 선행사로 하는 목적격 관계대명사입니다. 'we met'에서 목적어 역할을 합니다.

questions.sentence: The company ______ headquarters are in Seoul expanded to Busan.
questions.explanation: 'whose'는 소유격 관계대명사로 '~의'라는 의미입니다. 'The company's headquarters'를 관계절로 연결합니다.

questions.sentence: ______ the sales figures have improved, customer satisfaction remains low.
questions.explanation: 'Although'는 양보의 접속사로 '~에도 불구하고'라는 의미이며, 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 옵니다.

questions.sentence: The proposal will be approved ______ all committee members agree.
questions.explanation: 'provided that'은 '~한다면, ~라는 조건하에'라는 의미의 조건 접속사입니다.

questions.sentence: The marketing team increased spending, ______ the finance team reduced costs.
questions.explanation: 'whereas'는 '반면에'라는 의미로 대조를 나타내는 접속사입니다.

questions.sentence: The new software significantly improved the company's ______.
questions.explanation: 소유격(company's) 뒤에는 명사가 와야 합니다. 'productivity(생산성)'가 명사형입니다.

questions.sentence: The results were ______ impressive, exceeding all expectations.
questions.explanation: 형용사(impressive)를 수식하는 것은 부사입니다. 'remarkably(놀랍게도)'가 부사형입니다.

questions.sentence: The ______ of the new product was delayed due to supply issues.
questions.explanation: 관사 'The' 뒤에, 전치사 'of' 앞에는 명사가 필요합니다. 'launch'는 명사로 '출시'를 의미합니다.

questions.sentence: Neither the manager nor the employees ______ aware of the policy change.
questions.explanation: 'Neither A nor B'에서 동사는 B(the employees, 복수)에 수를 일치시킵니다.

questions.sentence: Each of the candidates ______ required to submit a portfolio.
questions.explanation: 'Each of + 복수명사'에서 주어는 'Each'(단수)이므로 단수 동사 'is'를 사용합니다.

questions.sentence: The number of applicants ______ increased dramatically this year.
questions.explanation: 'The number of'는 '~의 수'라는 의미로 단수 취급합니다. 반면 'A number of'는 '많은'이라는 의미로 복수 취급합니다.

questions.sentence: Ms. Kim is responsible ______ managing the overseas accounts.
questions.explanation: 'responsible for'는 '~에 대해 책임이 있는'이라는 의미의 고정 표현입니다.

questions.sentence: The seminar was postponed ______ a scheduling conflict.
questions.explanation: 'due to'는 '~때문에'라는 의미의 전치사구로, 뒤에 명사(구)가 옵니다.

questions.sentence: The factory ______ last year has already reached full production capacity.
questions.explanation: 과거분사 'built'이 'The factory'를 수식하는 분사구문입니다. 공장이 '지어진' 것이므로 수동의 의미인 과거분사를 사용합니다.

questions.sentence: Employees are encouraged to submit suggestions ______ improving workplace safety.
questions.explanation: 'suggestions for ~ing'는 '~하기 위한 제안'이라는 의미의 자연스러운 표현입니다.

questions.sentence: Had the shipment arrived on time, we ______ met the deadline.
questions.explanation: 'Had + S + p.p.'는 가정법 과거완료의 도치 구문입니다. 주절에는 'would have + p.p.'가 옵니다.

questions.sentence: The ______ of the new branch office is expected to take three months.
questions.explanation: 관사 The와 전치사 of 사이에는 명사가 필요. construction = 건설

questions.sentence: All employees must attend the ______ training session on Friday.
questions.explanation: 명사 training session을 수식하는 형용사 자리. mandatory = 의무적인

questions.sentence: The CEO spoke ______ about the company's future plans.
questions.explanation: 동사 spoke를 수식하는 부사 자리. enthusiastically = 열정적으로

questions.sentence: Customer ______ has improved significantly since the new policy was implemented.
questions.explanation: 주어 자리에는 명사. Customer satisfaction = 고객 만족

questions.sentence: The committee made a ______ decision to postpone the project.
questions.explanation: 명사 decision을 수식하는 형용사. unanimous = 만장일치의

questions.sentence: The ______ designed website attracted more visitors than expected.
questions.explanation: 과거분사 designed를 수식하는 부사. professionally designed = 전문적으로 설계된

questions.sentence: We need to find a ______ solution to the ongoing supply chain issues.
questions.explanation: 명사 solution을 수식하는 형용사. viable = 실행 가능한

questions.sentence: The manager's ______ to detail ensured that the project was completed without errors.
questions.explanation: 소유격 뒤 + 전치사 to 앞 = 명사 자리. attention to detail = 세부사항에 대한 주의

questions.sentence: Prices are subject to change without ______ notice.
questions.explanation: 명사 notice를 수식하는 형용사. prior notice = 사전 통지

questions.sentence: The annual report provides a ______ overview of the company's financial performance.
questions.explanation: 명사 overview를 수식하는 형용사. comprehensive = 포괄적인

questions.sentence: The renovation project was completed ______ ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: 부사 ahead를 수식하는 부사. considerably = 상당히

questions.sentence: The board expressed ______ for the work done by the marketing team.
questions.explanation: 동사 expressed의 목적어 = 명사. appreciation = 감사

questions.sentence: The company's ______ to innovation has led to several breakthrough products.
questions.explanation: 소유격 뒤 + 전치사 to 앞 = 명사. commitment = 헌신

questions.sentence: Please handle the fragile equipment ______.
questions.explanation: 동사 handle을 수식하는 부사. carefully = 조심히

questions.sentence: The new regulation is ______ effective as of next Monday.
questions.explanation: 형용사 effective를 수식하는 부사. immediately = 즉시

questions.sentence: Mr. Park received ______ for his outstanding contribution to the project.
questions.explanation: 동사 received의 목적어 = 명사. recognition = 인정

questions.sentence: The new policy aims to ______ workplace safety standards.
questions.explanation: to 부정사 뒤는 동사원형. strengthen = 강화하다

questions.sentence: ______ feedback from customers helped improve the product design.
questions.explanation: 명사 feedback을 수식하는 형용사. Constructive = 건설적인

questions.sentence: The finance department conducted a ______ review of all expenditures.
questions.explanation: 명사 review를 수식하는 형용사. thorough = 철저한

questions.sentence: All applicants will be evaluated ______ based on their qualifications.
questions.explanation: 동사 evaluated를 수식하는 부사. solely = 오로지, 단독으로

questions.sentence: The seminar will be held ______ the Grand Ballroom at the Hilton Hotel.
questions.explanation: 넓은 공간(방, 홀) 안에서는 in을 사용. in the Grand Ballroom = 대연회장에서

questions.sentence: The product recall was initiated in response ______ customer complaints.
questions.explanation: in response to = ~에 대응하여 (고정 표현)

questions.sentence: The merger is subject ______ approval by the regulatory authorities.
questions.explanation: be subject to = ~의 대상이다 (고정 표현)

questions.sentence: The supervisor congratulated the team ______ their excellent performance.
questions.explanation: congratulate A on B = B에 대해 A를 축하하다

questions.sentence: All inquiries should be directed ______ the customer service department.
questions.explanation: direct A to B = A를 B로 보내다/안내하다

questions.sentence: The warranty does not apply ______ products purchased from unauthorized retailers.
questions.explanation: apply to = ~에 적용되다

questions.sentence: Employees are eligible ______ a 15% discount on all company products.
questions.explanation: be eligible for = ~에 대한 자격이 있다

questions.sentence: The charity event raised funds ______ behalf of the local children's hospital.
questions.explanation: on behalf of = ~을 대신하여, ~을 위하여

questions.sentence: Attendance at the safety briefing is mandatory ______ exception.
questions.explanation: without exception = 예외 없이

questions.sentence: The results were ______ line with what the analysts had predicted.
questions.explanation: in line with = ~에 부합하여, ~에 따라

questions.sentence: Prior ______ the meeting, please review the attached documents.
questions.explanation: prior to = ~전에 (= before)

questions.sentence: The budget was cut ______ 20 percent compared to last year.
questions.explanation: by + 수치 = ~만큼 (증감의 폭)

questions.sentence: Please refrain ______ using your mobile phone during the presentation.
questions.explanation: refrain from = ~을 삼가다

questions.sentence: The conference will take place ______ March 15 and 17.
questions.explanation: between A and B = A와 B 사이에 (두 시점)

questions.sentence: ______ further notice, the parking lot on the east side will be closed.
questions.explanation: until further notice = 추후 통지가 있을 때까지

questions.sentence: The new policy was implemented ______ accordance with industry regulations.
questions.explanation: in accordance with = ~에 따라

questions.sentence: Employees must comply ______ all safety procedures at all times.
questions.explanation: comply with = ~을 준수하다

questions.sentence: The company has invested heavily ______ renewable energy technology.
questions.explanation: invest in = ~에 투자하다

questions.sentence: The award ceremony was held in honor ______ the retiring CEO.
questions.explanation: in honor of = ~을 기리어, ~을 기념하여

questions.sentence: Applicants should submit their résumés no later ______ December 31.
questions.explanation: no later than = 늦어도 ~까지

questions.sentence: ______ the economy shows signs of recovery, consumer spending remains low.
questions.explanation: Even though는 접속사로 뒤에 절(S+V)이 옴. In spite of는 전치사로 명사가 와야 함

questions.sentence: The shipment was delayed; ______, the client agreed to extend the deadline.
questions.explanation: 세미콜론 뒤에는 접속부사. nevertheless = 그럼에도 불구하고

questions.sentence: ______ there are enough participants, the workshop will be held as planned.
questions.explanation: Provided that = ~라는 조건 하에 (접속사, 뒤에 절)

questions.sentence: The company expanded its product line ______ attract a wider customer base.
questions.explanation: in order to + 동사원형 = ~하기 위해. so that 뒤에는 절이 와야 함

questions.sentence: Sales increased dramatically; ______, profits did not improve.
questions.explanation: however = 그러나 (대조). therefore/consequently = 따라서 (인과)

questions.sentence: ______ Mr. Lee is new to the company, he has already made significant contributions.
questions.explanation: Although는 접속사 + 절. Despite는 전치사 + 명사

questions.sentence: The building was evacuated ______ the fire alarm went off.
questions.explanation: as soon as = ~하자마자 (접속사 + 절)

questions.sentence: The project was successful ______ the limited budget.
questions.explanation: despite는 전치사 + 명사(구). although/even though는 접속사 + 절

questions.sentence: Please confirm your attendance ______ we can finalize the seating arrangement.
questions.explanation: so that + S + can/will = ~할 수 있도록

questions.sentence: The company hired additional staff; ______, it outsourced some tasks.
questions.explanation: in addition = 게다가, 또한 (추가)

questions.sentence: ______ submitting the report, please double-check all figures.
questions.explanation: Before + Ving = ~하기 전에. Prior는 prior to + 명사 형태

questions.sentence: The discount applies to online orders ______ in-store purchases.
questions.explanation: as well as = ~뿐만 아니라 (전치사적 접속사)

questions.sentence: The CEO will visit the factory ______ inspecting the new production line.
questions.explanation: for the purpose of + Ving = ~하기 위해

questions.sentence: ______ the rain stops, the outdoor event will be canceled.
questions.explanation: Unless = ~하지 않는 한 (= if not)

questions.sentence: Ms. Park was promoted ______ her exceptional leadership skills.
questions.explanation: owing to = ~때문에 (전치사 + 명사구). = because of, due to

questions.sentence: The building ______ renovated by the time the new tenants move in.
questions.explanation: by the time + 현재시제 → 주절은 미래완료. 건물이 '개조되는' 것이므로 수동태

questions.sentence: Applications ______ after the deadline will not be considered.
questions.explanation: 과거분사 received가 Applications를 수식. 지원서가 '받아진' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사

questions.sentence: The budget for next year ______ not yet been finalized.
questions.explanation: not yet(아직 ~않다) → 현재완료 has + been finalized

questions.sentence: The new regulations ______ into effect last month.
questions.explanation: last month(과거 시점) → 과거시제 went

questions.sentence: Once the contract ______, both parties will begin implementation.
questions.explanation: Once(일단 ~하면) 뒤에는 현재시제. 계약이 '서명되는' 것이므로 수동태

questions.sentence: The company ______ three new branches since the beginning of the year.
questions.explanation: since + 과거시점 → 현재완료 has opened

questions.sentence: All employees ______ to complete the training by the end of the month.
questions.explanation: 직원들이 '요구받는' 것이므로 수동태 are required

questions.sentence: The package ______ delivered to the wrong address yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday(과거) → 과거 수동태 was delivered

questions.sentence: By next quarter, the company ______ its expansion into three new markets.
questions.explanation: By next quarter(미래 시점까지) → 미래완료 will have completed

questions.sentence: The research team ______ on the project for over two years now.
questions.explanation: for over two years + now → 현재완료진행 has been working

questions.sentence: The proposal ______ reviewed by the committee before it was approved.
questions.explanation: 승인되기 '전에' 검토됨 → 과거완료 수동태 had been reviewed

questions.sentence: The factory ______ currently ______ upgraded to meet new safety standards.
questions.explanation: currently(현재) → 현재진행 수동태 is being upgraded

questions.sentence: Ms. Chen ______ as the regional director since 2020.
questions.explanation: since 2020 → 현재완료 has served

questions.sentence: The report ______ be submitted by 5 P.M. today.
questions.explanation: must be submitted = 제출되어야 한다 (의무의 조동사)

questions.sentence: If I ______ about the meeting, I would have attended.
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거완료: If + had p.p., would have p.p.

questions.sentence: The two companies merged, combining ______ resources and expertise.
questions.explanation: 두 회사의 자원 → 소유격 their (복수)

questions.sentence: ______ interested in the position should submit an application by Friday.
questions.explanation: Those + 형용사/분사 = ~한 사람들. Those interested = 관심 있는 사람들

questions.sentence: The manager asked the employees to familiarize ______ with the new software.
questions.explanation: 재귀대명사 themselves. familiarize oneself with = ~에 익숙해지다

questions.sentence: ______ of the proposals submitted met the client's requirements.
questions.explanation: None of + 명사 = ~중 아무것도 아닌

questions.sentence: The hotel offers ______ guests complimentary breakfast every morning.
questions.explanation: The hotel(단수) → 소유격 its. it's = it is

questions.sentence: Employees may choose ______ the health plan or the dental plan.
questions.explanation: either A or B = A 또는 B 중 하나

questions.sentence: The conference room is available for ______ who needs it.
questions.explanation: anyone who = ~하는 누구든

questions.sentence: ______ employee is expected to follow the company's code of conduct.
questions.explanation: Every + 단수명사 = 모든 ~. All + 복수명사

questions.sentence: The laptops are identical; there is no difference between ______.
questions.explanation: 전치사 between 뒤에는 목적격 them

questions.sentence: Ms. Lee completed the report by ______ without any assistance.
questions.explanation: by oneself = 혼자서. 재귀대명사 herself

questions.sentence: The clients were pleased with the service and expressed ______ gratitude.
questions.explanation: The clients(복수) → 소유격 their

questions.sentence: ______ suggestions are welcome and will be reviewed by management.
questions.explanation: All + 복수명사 + 복수동사. Every/Each + 단수명사

questions.sentence: The supervisor assigned the task to Mr. Kim and ______.
questions.explanation: 전치사 to의 목적어 → 목적격 me. 'to Mr. Kim and me'

questions.sentence: ______ the two options, the first one seems more cost-effective.
questions.explanation: Of the two options = 두 선택지 중에서

questions.sentence: The company prides ______ on its commitment to customer service.
questions.explanation: pride oneself on = ~을 자랑하다. 재귀대명사 itself

questions.sentence: The board of directors will ______ the annual budget at the next meeting.
questions.explanation: review = 검토하다. renew = 갱신, revise = 수정, revoke = 취소

questions.sentence: All employees are ______ to attend the fire safety drill on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: be required to = ~해야 한다. acquired = 취득된, inquired = 문의된

questions.sentence: The company plans to ______ its operations to Southeast Asia.
questions.explanation: expand operations = 사업을 확장하다. expend = 소비하다

questions.sentence: Customers may ______ a full refund within 30 days of purchase.
questions.explanation: request a refund = 환불을 요청하다

questions.sentence: The new software will ______ employees to work more efficiently.
questions.explanation: enable A to V = A가 V하는 것을 가능하게 하다

questions.sentence: Ms. Kim was ______ promoted to the position of vice president.
questions.explanation: recently promoted = 최근에 승진한

questions.sentence: The marketing campaign was ______ successful in reaching younger consumers.
questions.explanation: particularly = 특히. partially = 부분적으로

questions.sentence: The company ______ a new policy regarding remote work arrangements.
questions.explanation: implement a policy = 정책을 시행하다

questions.sentence: The CEO will ______ the keynote speech at the industry conference.
questions.explanation: deliver a speech = 연설하다

questions.sentence: Tickets for the event are available on a first-come, first-______ basis.
questions.explanation: first-come, first-served = 선착순

questions.sentence: The construction project is ______ to be completed by the end of the year.
questions.explanation: be expected to = ~할 것으로 예상되다

questions.sentence: Please ______ the enclosed form and return it by April 15.
questions.explanation: complete a form = 양식을 작성하다

questions.sentence: The firm has ______ a reputation for excellent customer service.
questions.explanation: establish a reputation = 명성을 쌓다

questions.sentence: Employees are ______ encouraged to participate in the wellness program.
questions.explanation: strongly encouraged = 강력히 권장되는

questions.sentence: The proposal was ______ rejected by the committee due to budget constraints.
questions.explanation: unanimously rejected = 만장일치로 거부된

questions.sentence: The factory operates ______ the clock to meet the production deadline.
questions.explanation: around the clock = 24시간 내내

questions.sentence: The lease agreement ______ that tenants must give 60 days' notice.
questions.explanation: stipulate = 규정하다, 명시하다

questions.sentence: The company's profits have grown ______ over the past five years.
questions.explanation: steadily = 꾸준히. steeply = 가파르게

questions.sentence: The supervisor ______ the employees for their hard work during the busy season.
questions.explanation: commend = 칭찬하다. command = 명령하다, commence = 시작하다

questions.sentence: The seminar will ______ a wide range of topics related to digital marketing.
questions.explanation: cover topics = 주제를 다루다

questions.sentence: The company is ______ seeking qualified candidates for the open position.
questions.explanation: actively seeking = 적극적으로 찾고 있는

questions.sentence: Profits ______ sharply in the third quarter due to decreased demand.
questions.explanation: decline = 감소하다. decide = 결정하다

questions.sentence: The ______ date for the project submission is November 30.
questions.explanation: deadline date = 마감일. 또는 deadline = 마감일(명사)

questions.sentence: The board ______ approved the merger after months of negotiations.
questions.explanation: finally approved = 마침내 승인했다

questions.sentence: The new regulation is ______ to take effect at the beginning of next year.
questions.explanation: be scheduled to = ~할 예정이다

questions.sentence: A variety of training programs ______ available to all employees.
